name: web-ai-search-analytics-landing-page-white-and-indigo
title: Long white AI-visibility analytics landing page with dashboards and pricing
whatItIs: A tall white page with a centred headline 'See where your brand's position in AI search', a big dashboard screenshot, logos, a four-card feature grid, a three-tier pricing table, a section with a large screenshot on an indigo panel, a testimonial grid, an indigo gradient CTA panel, and a footer with an enormous faint wordmark.
whatItMeans: Clean, professional and data-forward; indigo panels punctuate a mostly white system.
techniques: Lead with a real dashboard screenshot under a centred headline.
Show a faint enormous wordmark at the footer.
Use one indigo panel for the CTA and one for a feature.
Present pricing as three cards with the middle emphasised.
Grid of testimonial cards with logos.

vocabulary.definition: A hero built around a product screenshot.
A grid of cards explaining capabilities.
A grid of customer quotes with names and logos.
A giant low-contrast brand name in the footer.
